text:
sasha: noticed a persistent discrepancy between v1 and v2 in the console for a small shadow cohort: v2 p95 is ~180-220ms vs v1 ~110-130ms, and token accounting is ~10% higher on v2 for identical requests.
arjun: could be batching or a header rename affecting billing. any rollout toggles?
sasha: rollout flags show shadow cohort flipped to v2 earlier today. infra-bot: flag-change: release.toggle.v2_shadow cohort=shadow-B at 2025-04-12T09:15:02Z
tess: micro-batching on v2 would increase tail for short seqs. we also changed fallback preference to quantized variants under load.
arjun: agree. propose quick isolation: pin traffic to variants on same pool for 60m and run synthetic load (N=500 short requests) capturing batch-size and kernel-tag headers.
sasha: i'll add a temporary console panel for "batch-size distribution" and "kernel-path" by variant/cohort.
tess: i'll run the synthetic harness and include cache-hit header capture. arjun: i'll instrument the routing-logs to filter cohort=shadow-B and watch for mixed-variant routing.
product-bot: product-notify: heads-up that engineers are investigating latency delta between API variants; may pause broader rollout if confirmed.
sasha: plan set. will reconvene here with data.
